_comments: Expected recurring deposits. Same shape and same occurrence rules as bills.json —
see the comment block there for what each field means. The only differences:
amount .......... Dollars, positive. It is ADDED to the projection, not subtracted.
match_keywords .. Used to recognise the deposit in the bank feed.
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored. The list lives under the "income" key;
a bare JSON array is also accepted.

income.name: NJ unemployment
income.note: Added 11 Sep 2026. Replaces the weekly Insight Global payroll, which ended. $869/week as stated by the household. ANCHOR IS AN ASSUMPTION: set to 18 Sep 2026 so the first modelled payment falls after today's entered balance rather than on top of it. Correct the anchor to the real payment weekday once one is seen on a statement, and clear needs_review. Benefits are time-limited - record the exhaustion date here when it is known, as ends_on, or the forecast will run this income forever. starts_on is set to 12 Sep 2026 because a weekly/biweekly anchor is a phase marker, not a start date - the engine walks backwards from it, and without the bound this would also fire on 11 Sep, on top of a balance that already contains it.

Confirm the real pay date and amount on the first statement, then clear needs_review. starts_on is set to 12 Sep 2026 because a weekly/biweekly anchor is a phase marker, not a start date - the engine walks backwards from it, and without the bound this would also fire on 11 Sep, on top of a balance that already contains it.
